# The Till Screensaver

After a few minutes without use, the till screen goes black and shows a slowly drifting logo with your store name and the time. That's the screensaver. Tap the screen, or press any key, and you're back exactly where you were.

It doesn't sign anyone out, doesn't lose the cart, and doesn't interrupt anything. The tap that wakes it is swallowed deliberately, so you can't accidentally press a button you couldn't see.

![POS Screensaver](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/8923d88c-1d8f-479e-8e3d-2a1b17d0d870.png)

---

## Changing how long it waits

1. Open **Settings** from the bottom of the side menu.
2. Find the **Screensaver** row.
3. Use **−** and **+** to set anywhere between **1 and 15 minutes**. The default is 5.

![POS Screensaver settings](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/42efb90d-8866-4f89-beb8-ae78c32dcc65.png)

The change takes effect within a few seconds. There's no need to reload or sign out.

* Note: This setting is saved on **this till only**. Each terminal in your store has its own, so a back-office till and a counter till can be set differently. Settings rows marked "this till only" work this way; everything else applies to every terminal in the store.

---

## Why it can't be turned off

Tills usually run with the tablet's own sleep switched off, so the screen is lit all day. Left showing the same image for hours, a display can retain a faint permanent ghost of it. The drifting screensaver is what prevents that, which is why the longest setting is 15 minutes rather than "never".

---

## If the screen goes fully dark instead

The OrderHub screensaver is always a **black screen with a drifting logo, your store name and a clock**. If instead the display goes completely off, or shows something else entirely, that's the tablet's own screen timeout or its kiosk software — not OrderHub, and changing this setting won't affect it. You'd change that in the tablet's own settings.

---

## Good to know

* **It isn't a logout.** Staff stay signed in behind the screensaver. See **Signing In and Out at the Till**.
* **Settings has a separate five-minute lock.** If you're sitting in the Settings screen and leave it for five minutes, it asks for the PIN again. That's unrelated to the screensaver and isn't configurable.
